method.score: activity × clear sky × darkness × moon & lights
method.clear_definition: at least 2 consecutive dark hours with cloud cover ≤ 40%

weekly.geomagnetic: Geomagnetic field activity is expected to reach active to G1 storm levels on 24-25 Sep due to positive polarity CH HSS effects. Unsettled to active levels are expected on 26-27 Sep and 04-08 Oct due to positive polarity CH HSS effects. Quiet to unsettled levels are expected on 11-14 Oct due to negative polarity CH HSS effects. Largely quiet levels are anticipated for all remaining dates in the forecast period.

three_day.rationale: No G1 (Minor) or greater geomagnetic storms are expected through 29 Sep as no significant transient or recurrent solar wind features are forecast.
three_day.summary: The greatest expected 3 hr Kp for Sep 27-Sep 29 2026 is 4.00 (below NOAA Scale levels)
